name: Splendid Flops: Famous Things That Went Wrong
description: Ships that sank on launch, bubbles that burst, machines no one wanted and companies that vanished: the grand failures that taught more than the successes.

checkpoints.name: Ruin in the old world
checkpoints.note: The Late Bronze Age collapse ends great kingdoms, and the settlers of Roanoke Colony vanish without a trace.

checkpoints.name: Bubbles and bridges
checkpoints.note: The warship Vasa sinks within sight of Stockholm, Tulip mania and Railway Mania show how crowds chase prices, SS Great Eastern ruins its owners and the Tay Bridge disaster kills in a storm.

checkpoints.name: Wrecks, crashes and airships
checkpoints.note: The Titanic sinks on her first voyage in 1912, the Wall Street Crash of 1929 starts a depression, the airship Hindenburg burns, and the de Havilland Comet shows the risks of jet travel.

checkpoints.name: Tech flops and corporate falls
checkpoints.note: The N1 rocket fails on every launch, Concorde never finds enough buyers, the video game crash of 1983 hits, and the Apple Lisa and Newton, the Atari Jaguar, Virtual Boy and Dreamcast flop. Challenger breaks apart in 1986, Ariane 5 fails on its first launch, Barings and the Japanese bubble show how money can vanish, and Pan Am goes under in 1991.

checkpoints.name: The social and the digital
checkpoints.note: The dot-com bubble bursts, taking Webvan and Pets.com with it, and fraud ends Enron. Blockbuster fades before streaming, Myspace and Friendster lose to rivals, Vista and the Zune disappoint, the A380 and Tata Nano miss their markets, Lehman Brothers falls in 2008, and Google+, Vine and Stadia close.
